target_geographic_bounds.description: Indian Ocean Basin including Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, and Southern Indian Ocean

environment.credentials_policy: NOAA and ESA CCI datasets are open-access public data requiring no authentication. Argovis API token is optional (higher rate limits); obtain through Argovis official registration.

bathymetry.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
bathymetry.access_method: Direct NetCDF subset via OPeNDAP / NOAA NCEI
transformations: Spatial bounding box slice to [-45, 32] lat and [20, 125] lon
Regridded to standard 0.25-deg resolution grid (309 x 421)
Converted to int16 binary format for fast WebGL and backend binary reads
bathymetry.known_limitations: Regridded to 0.25-deg resolution from 60-arcsec resolution to match ocean model grids. Features smaller than ~25 km are smoothed.
bathymetry.resume_instructions: Dataset is complete. No resumption required.

daily_sst.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
daily_sst.product: NOAA Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (OISST) v2.1
daily_sst.access_method: Direct HTTPS download with parallel ThreadPoolExecutor workers
daily_sst.actual_temporal_coverage: 2020-01-01 to 2024-12-31 (1,827 days continuous, leap year 2020 & 2024 included)
transformations: Downloaded daily NetCDF files directly from official NOAA NCEI HTTPS archives
Cropped in-memory to Indian Ocean bounding box [lat: -45 to 32, lon: 20 to 125]
Standardized variable name 'sst' to 'tos_daily'
Saved yearly NetCDFs (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) and merged master 5-year NetCDF
daily_sst.known_limitations: Surface water temperature only (~top 1 meter). In-situ buoy calibration and satellite blending subject to satellite cloud cover.
daily_sst.resume_instructions: Dataset is complete for 2020-2024. To extend back to 2015, run `python backend/scripts/fetch_ncei_daily_sst.py --start-year 2015 --end-year 2019`.

chlorophyll.provider: European Space Agency (ESA) Ocean Colour Climate Change Initiative (CCI) v6.0 via NOAA OceanWatch ERDDAP
chlorophyll.product: ESA CCI Ocean Colour Monthly 4km Composites (Regridded to 0.25-deg)
chlorophyll.actual_temporal_coverage: 1998-01-01 to 2025-01-01 (325 continuous monthly composites across 27 years)
transformations: Downloaded yearly subsets from NOAA OceanWatch ERDDAP
Regridded and cropped to standard 0.25-deg grid over Indian Ocean
Standardized variable 'chlor_a' to 'chl'
Compiled master 325-month NetCDF dataset with 27,192,542 verified non-empty physical observations
chlorophyll.known_limitations: Surface optical proxy derived from satellite ocean colour radiance (SeaWiFS, MODIS, MERIS, OLCI). Cannot observe phytoplankton below the photic zone (~top 30-50m). Cloud cover creates intermittent coastal gaps.
chlorophyll.resume_instructions: Dataset is complete. No resumption required.

sea_surface_height.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) / Physical Sciences Laboratory (PSL)
sea_surface_height.product: Global Ocean Data Assimilation System (GODAS) Monthly Sea Surface Height Relative to Geoid (sshg)
sea_surface_height.spatial_resolution: 1/3 degree latitude x 1 degree longitude (231 lat x 105 lon)
transformations: Slices along time, lat, and lon on PSL THREDDS
Renamed variable 'sshg' to CF-standard 'zos'
Concatenated 25 annual NetCDFs into single master dataset
sea_surface_height.known_limitations: Model-assimilated reanalysis product (assimilating satellite altimetry and XBT/Argo data). Coarse zonal grid (1 degree).
sea_surface_height.resume_instructions: Dataset is complete for 2000-2024. No resumption required.

mixed_layer_depth.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) / Physical Sciences Laboratory (PSL)
mixed_layer_depth.product: Global Ocean Data Assimilation System (GODAS) Monthly Mixed Layer Depth (dbss_obml)
mixed_layer_depth.spatial_resolution: 1/3 degree latitude x 1 degree longitude (231 lat x 105 lon)
transformations: Slices along time, lat, and lon on PSL THREDDS
Renamed variable 'dbss_obml' to CF-standard 'mlotst'
Concatenated 25 annual NetCDFs into single master dataset
mixed_layer_depth.known_limitations: Model-assimilated reanalysis diagnostic based on potential density difference criteria. Not a direct in-situ measurement.
mixed_layer_depth.resume_instructions: Dataset is complete for 2000-2024. No resumption required.

in_situ_observations.provider: Argo GDAC / Argovis API / IMOS Australian Ocean Data Network (AODN)
in_situ_observations.product: Argo Core CTD Profiles, BGC-Argo Optical Profiles, and IMOS Ocean Glider Missions
in_situ_observations.access_method: Argovis REST API queries + HTTPS direct NetCDF downloads
in_situ_observations.requested_domain: Indian Ocean sensor networks (Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, Equatorial IO, Southern IO)
in_situ_observations.actual_temporal_coverage: Argo profiles: 2018-05-12 to 2024-03-30; Gliders: Sept 2017 & March 2019 missions
in_situ_observations.temporal_resolution: Per-profile surfacing and glider dive cycles
transformations: Extracted Argovis JSON payloads and verified QC flags (flag 1 = good)
Extracted depth, temperature, salinity, chlorophyll-a, dissolved oxygen arrays
Downloaded IMOS ocean glider NetCDFs and parsed high-frequency dive fixes
Stored structured records into indexed SQLite database (oceanscope_real.db)
in_situ_observations.known_limitations: In-situ profiling floats and gliders provide Lagrangian, sparse spatial sampling along drift trajectories, not a regular continuous 3D grid.
in_situ_observations.missing_coverage: Continuous global deployment expanding in real-time.
in_situ_observations.resume_instructions: To ingest more profiles, run `python backend/scripts/expand_real_observations.py` with modified bounding dates or box parameters.

temperature_3d.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) / Physical Sciences Laboratory (PSL)
temperature_3d.product: Global Ocean Data Assimilation System (GODAS) Monthly 3D Potential Temperature (pottmp)
temperature_3d.access_method: Month-by-month OPeNDAP slice via xarray to prevent socket timeouts
temperature_3d.spatial_resolution: 1/3 degree latitude x 1 degree longitude (231 lat x 105 lon)
transformations: Slices along time, lat, lon month-by-month to avoid PSL THREDDS socket truncation
Interpolates from raw 40 GODAS vertical levels to OceanScope 16 standard depths
Converts potential temperature from Kelvin to Celsius (val - 273.15)
Renames variable 'pottmp' to CF-compliant 'thetao'
Concatenates validated annual NetCDFs into master dataset
temperature_3d.known_limitations: Model-assimilated reanalysis product. 16 discrete standard depths interpolated from 40 model levels. Coarse 1-degree zonal resolution. Historical coverage prior to 2022 is pending acquisition.

salinity_3d.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) / Physical Sciences Laboratory (PSL)
salinity_3d.product: Global Ocean Data Assimilation System (GODAS) Monthly 3D Practical Salinity (salt)
salinity_3d.access_method: Month-by-month OPeNDAP slice via xarray to prevent socket timeouts
salinity_3d.spatial_resolution: 1/3 degree latitude x 1 degree longitude (231 lat x 105 lon)
transformations: Slices along time, lat, lon month-by-month to avoid PSL THREDDS socket truncation
Interpolates from raw 40 GODAS vertical levels to OceanScope 16 standard depths
Renames variable 'salt' to CF-compliant 'so'
Concatenates validated annual NetCDFs into master dataset
salinity_3d.known_limitations: Model-assimilated reanalysis product. 16 discrete standard depths interpolated from 40 model levels. Coarse 1-degree zonal resolution. Historical coverage prior to 2022 is pending acquisition.

currents_3d.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) / Physical Sciences Laboratory (PSL)
currents_3d.product: Global Ocean Data Assimilation System (GODAS) Monthly 3D Zonal & Meridional Currents (ucur, vcur)
currents_3d.access_method: Month-by-month OPeNDAP slice via xarray to prevent socket timeouts
currents_3d.spatial_resolution: 1/3 degree latitude x 1 degree longitude (231 lat x 106 lon)
transformations: Slices along time, lat, lon month-by-month to avoid PSL THREDDS socket truncation
Interpolates from raw 40 GODAS vertical levels to OceanScope 16 standard depths
Renames variables 'ucur' to 'uo' and 'vcur' to 'vo'
Combines uo and vo into a unified currents NetCDF dataset
currents_3d.known_limitations: Model-assimilated reanalysis velocity field. Staggered B-grid velocities interpolated to cell centers. Historical coverage prior to 2022 is pending acquisition.

density_3d.provider: UNESCO 1983 International Equation of State of Seawater (EOS-80)
density_3d.product: Seawater In-Situ Density Computed Directly from Real Verified GODAS T & S
density_3d.source_endpoint: DERIVED LOCALLY from temperature_godas_monthly_standard.nc and salinity_godas_monthly_standard.nc
density_3d.spatial_resolution: 1/3 degree latitude x 1 degree longitude (231 lat x 105 lon)
transformations: COMPUTED DERIVED FIELD (Not an independent observation)
Evaluates UNESCO 1983 EOS-80 high-pressure polynomial equation of state rho(S, T, p)
Calculates hydrostatic pressure from standard depths (p = 0.1 * depth_m)
Evaluated grid cell by grid cell for all 16 depth levels across 36 monthly timesteps
density_3d.known_limitations: Derived parameter calculated from GODAS reanalysis temperature and salinity. Inherits model errors and 1-degree zonal resolution.
density_3d.resume_point: Derived automatically upon completing missing T and S years
density_3d.resume_instructions: Automatically executed by `fetch_historical_godas_3d.py` or manually run `python -c "from backend.scripts.fetch_historical_godas_3d import derive_density_eos80; derive_density_eos80(2000, 2024)"`.
